blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three areas in the country are expected to experience dangerous heat indices of up to 42°C on Tuesday, Nov. 17, the state weather bureau reported. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) identified these areas as Puerto Princesa City, Palawan; Borongan, Eastern Samar; and Zamboanga City, Zamboanga del Sur.
